1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition) Book of Parables (1 Enoch 37-71) (c. 100 BC)

'And in those days the punishment of the Lord of Spirits shall go forth, and they shall open all the chambers of waters that are above the heavens, and the springs which are beneath the earth' — cosmic-water-judgment unleashing. Tewahedo eschatological readings (preserved in some Ge'ez liturgical homilies) preserve this water-judgment as parallel to but distinct from the Genesis Flood — eschatological reprise rather than primordial cleansing.
